hooks.command: $raw = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $json = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $f = $json.tool_input.file_path; if (-not $f -or -not ($f.EndsWith('.cs') -or $f.EndsWith('.csproj'))) { exit 0 }; $errs = @(); dotnet format tps.slnx 2>&1 | Out-Null; dotnet csharpier format . 2>&1 | Out-Null; $br = dotnet build tps.csharp 2>&1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $errs += 'Build tps.csharp failed:'; $errs += $br }; $br2 = dotnet build tps.godot 2>&1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $errs += 'Build tps.godot failed:'; $errs += $br2 }; if ($errs.Count -eq 0) { $tr = dotnet test tps.csharp.test --no-build 2>&1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $errs += 'Tests failed:'; $errs += $tr } }; if ($errs.Count -gt 0) { @{hookSpecificOutput=@{hookEventName='PostToolUse';additionalContext=($errs -join [char]10)}} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress }
